content:
The Waterfall API is available at `https://api.waterfall.io`. Send your API key in the `x-api-key` header. See [Authentication](/v1/authentication).

## Endpoints

| API | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [Prospector](/v1/prospector-launcher) | Async | Find people at a company by domain and title filters, with available emails and optional phones. |
| [Search Contact](/v1/search-contact-launcher) | Sync | Find profiles by LinkedIn, company, or supported company-set and role filters. Emails and phones are excluded. |
| [Search Company](/v1/search-company-launcher) | Sync | Find companies by industry, headquarters country, or headcount range. Preview. |
| [Contact Enrichment](/v1/contact-enrichment-launcher) | Async | Find profile data and available contact details from an email, LinkedIn identifier, or name and company domain. |
| [Phone Enrichment](/v1/phone-enrichment-launcher) | Async | Find available phone numbers for a known person. |
| [Company Enrichment](/v1/company-enrichment-launcher) | Async | Find company details from a domain, LinkedIn identifier, or company name. |
| [Company Reveal](/v1/company-reveal-launcher) | Sync | Look up company context from an IPv4 address, with entity type and confidence. |
| [Company Titles](/v1/company-titles-launcher) | Sync | Retrieve active job titles at a company by domain or LinkedIn identifier. Preview; requires access on your key. |
| [Job Change](/v1/job-change-launcher) | Sync | Check a contact’s company information and return an employment-change outcome with an available profile. |
| [Email Verification](/v1/email-verifier) | Sync | Check a specific email address and return its verification status. |
| [Webhook JWKS](/v1/webhook-jwks) | Sync | Fetch public Ed25519 keys for verifying signed webhook deliveries. |
| [Account Reporting](/v1/account-reporter-v2) | Sync | Read usage for the account and authenticated key, plus the current account balance. |
| [API Key Management](/v1/api-keys-overview) | Sync | List account keys and create or update sub-keys using a master key. |

Choose an API based on what you already know and what you want to find. The guidance below separates search, enrichment, verification, and employment checks.

## Find people and contact details

| API | What you have | What you get |
|---|---|---|
| [Prospector](/v1/prospector-launcher) | Company domain + title filter | Matching people, with available emails and optional phones |
| [Search Contact](/v1/search-contact-launcher) | Person’s LinkedIn, company identifiers, or [company-set filters](/v1/search-contact-filters) | Professional profiles; no emails or phones |
| [Contact Enrichment](/v1/contact-enrichment-launcher) | Email, person’s LinkedIn, or name + company domain | Profile and available contact details |
| [Phone Enrichment](/v1/phone-enrichment-launcher) | Email, person’s LinkedIn, or name + company domain | Available phone numbers |
| [Email Verification](/v1/email-verifier) | Email address | Email verification status |

**Search Contact or Prospector?** Use Search Contact when you need profile search and structured filters. Use Prospector when you have a target account and want to find people and contact details by title. To enrich someone found through Search Contact, pass their LinkedIn identifier to Contact Enrichment. See [account prospecting](/v1/use-cases/account-prospecting) for the workflow.

## Find and enrich companies

| API | What you have | What you get |
|---|---|---|
| [Company Enrichment](/v1/company-enrichment-launcher) | Company domain, LinkedIn identifier, or name | Available company details |
| [Search Company](/v1/search-company-launcher) (Preview) | Industry, headquarters country, or headcount filters | Matching company profiles |
| [Company Titles](/v1/company-titles-launcher) (Preview) | Company domain or LinkedIn identifier | Active job titles for title targeting |
| [Company Reveal](/v1/company-reveal-launcher) | Website visitor’s IPv4 address | Company match, entity type, and confidence |

For existing CRM records, use [CRM enrichment](/v1/use-cases/crm-enrichment). For website traffic, start with [website company identification](/v1/use-cases/website-company-identification).

## Check a contact’s employment

[Job Change](/v1/job-change-launcher) checks a contact’s company information and returns a status with an available profile snapshot. Start with a supported company-and-contact identifier combination or a professional email. If you need recurring checks, your workflow schedules the requests and compares the results. See [job changes](/v1/use-cases/job-changes).

## When do results arrive?

For **async** APIs, the launcher returns a `job_id`. Retrieve the result with the matching Finder or receive it through `webhook_url`. For **sync** data APIs, read the result in the POST response. Where a Finder exists, use it to retrieve the saved result later. Email Verification has no Finder. The job’s `status` describes processing. Inspect the returned data to decide whether it is useful for your task. A `SUCCEEDED` job does not promise that every requested field was found.

Search Company and Company Titles are **Preview** APIs. Their behavior may change. Check the relevant reference before building a critical workflow around a Preview API.

## Manage your integration

- [API Keys Management](/v1/api-keys-overview): create and manage keys for your workflows.
- [Usage Tracking](/v1/inline-usage): inspect a job’s returned cost and balance snapshot.
- [Account Reporting](/v1/account-reporter-v2): read usage across a date range.
- [Webhook Verification](/v1/webhook-verification): verify the origin and integrity of signed deliveries.

Ready to try a contact lookup? Follow the [quickstart](/v1/quickstart). If you are comparing providers, use the [evaluation guide](/v1/evaluate-waterfall). Working with an agent? Start with [Use Waterfall with an agent](/v1/skills-overview) to run a lookup or build an integration.
